sanskrit:
महर्षीणां भृगुरहं गिरामस्म्येकमक्षरम् ।
यज्ञानां जपयज्ञोऽस्मि स्थावराणां हिमालयः ॥ १०-२५॥
iast:
maharṣīṇāṃ bhṛgurahaṃ girāmasmyekamakṣaram
yajñānāṃ japayajño’smi sthāvarāṇāṃ himālayaḥ 10-25
translation: Among the great RISHIS I am Bhrigu; among words I am the one-syllabled OM ; among sacrifices I am the sacrifice of silent repetition (JAPA-YAJNA) ; among immovable things the Himalayas.
